items.html: And behold, how his ChGT stand there in the potential of KHB, and the ChGT are now called his head, as mentioned. And there is there an impression of the growth of his head in general, even though not in particular; for they are now prepared, that when the GAR of Gadlut enter, the two upper articles in each one of their lines will divide to make KHB. But now his KHB are included in the ChGT and mixed there.
